messages:
elaine: Proposal: tiny cross-lang ResumeSession primitive to unify pagination + retries. SDK iterator yields pages and a resume_token. Who persists token? SDK or transport?

rashid: +1. Key Q: opaque server cursors or client idempotency tokens?

elaine: Both. Modes: SERVER_CURSOR, CLIENT_TOKEN, HYBRID. Server cursor = authoritative; client token helps across transports/expiry.

sam: Sketches for ergonomics please.

elaine: TS: async iterable pages, page.resumeToken optional.
Python: context manager stream with stream.resume_token after exit.
Go: iterator.Next() -> (page, token, err).

rashid: Prefetching concern: canonical resume token vs in-flight token. Keep "last acknowledged" separate. Expose on_token callback for checkpointing.

kevin: Transport retries: only safe for idempotent calls. For consuming pages, transport shouldn't retry blindly. SDK should surface ResumeableError with last_resume_token. Auto-resume optional.

maria: Add opt-in auto_resume with limited attempts/backoff; emit metrics resume.attempts/success/failure_reason.

sam: Ops: record client vs server resume usage in traces for billing/debug.

elaine: Plan: RFC (ResumePolicy enum + errors), SDK surfaces (resume_token attr, PersistResumeToken callback, auto_resume config), transport optional ResumeHandshake, docs + examples.

kevin: Edge cases: server cursor expiry -> ErrResumeExpired; partial page -> dedupe needed; cross-lang error model needs resume token attached.

maria: Keep RPC name list_items; SDK languages choose surface. Thin sugar.

ci-bot: "elaine" opened RFC PR 2345: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/2345

sam: I'll prototype TS async iterator and tests for token persist.

elaine: Owners: elaine (RFC + Python), sam (TS), rashid (Go), kevin (transport). Decision target: EOW.

maria: Thanks, looks good.
